action.objective: Play Nb5, hitting the c7 queen and d6 bishop, with a verified exact +29.
action.rationale: Nb5 is commit_ready: verified depth 3, exact score +29 (the only exact row in the broad search), safety.complete with no mate-in-one, tactical_refutation not_found. The knight attacks c7 (queen) and d6 (bishop); if Black ignores it, Nxc7 wins the queen for at best a bishop. Black's likely Bxf4 is answered in the PV, and Rxd4 is not a material threat to the knight. No deeper alternative exists: c3d5, f4d6 and f1e1 rows are all upper-bound estimates (can be far worse) at shallower/comparable depth, so they are not comparable evidence. No risk acceptance needed.
